summary:
Production-readiness execution plan for Tasks 2 through 6:
- Task 2: Security fixes (allowBackup=false, PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256 with securely stored Keystore salt, real BiometricPrompt integration with PIN fallback)
- Task 3: 3-Category SMS Parser (Confirmed, Scheduled Due with DueEntity, and Failed/Bounced classification) with unit tests
- Task 4: Account-to-SMS matching via last 4 digits and unassigned transaction UI
- Task 5: Manual account/transaction polish and Reconcile balance action
- Task 6: Room database schema migrations with MIGRATION_1_2 and MIGRATION_2_3 to preserve all user data
